summary: Facial-animation controller for a character model: blink and mouth timers, texture frame bytes and blend weights.

fields.name: eyeOpenAmount

fields.evidence: Second interpolated amount (mouth) written next to f_C4.

fields.name: blinkPhase
fields.evidence: Model_Face_UpdateBlink (0x00564ED8) stores the normalised blink progress (elapsedTime/blinkInterval, clamped to 1) times 0.05 there each frame while the blink sequence runs

fields.name: mouthWeight
fields.evidence: Model_Face_UpdateBlink (0x00564ED8) stores the computed mouth weight there and zeroes it when the mouth frame id becomes invalid

fields.name: eyeFrame
fields.evidence: Eye texture frame byte chosen from the curve table in Model_Face_UpdateBlink.

fields.name: mouthFrame
fields.evidence: Mouth texture frame byte, zeroed when the mouth sequence ends.

fields.name: blinkInterval
fields.evidence: Read as local_2c and used as the blink duration divisor (f_F4 / f_EC).

fields.name: mouthInterval
fields.evidence: Second interval used when the mouth flag (bit 1) is set.

fields.name: elapsedTime
fields.evidence: Model_Face_Update does self->f_F4 += deltaTime, and UpdateBlink compares it with the active interval.

fields.name: sequenceFlags
fields.evidence: Bit 0 = blink active, bit 1 = mouth active; cleared when a sequence ends.

fields.name: maybe_blinkEnableFlag
fields.evidence: Model_Face_Update (0x005652A4) only advances blinkCountdown when this word or +0x1C0 is non-zero, so it is an enable flag rather than a handle

fields.name: maybe_mouthEnableFlag
fields.evidence: Model_Face_Update (0x005652A4) ORs it with +0x1BC as the gate for the blink reschedule, so it is a second enable flag

fields.name: nextBlinkInterval
fields.evidence: Model_Face_Update (0x005652A4) computes it from the LCG random 0x0051B1FC scaled to [0,1) seconds just before reloading blinkCountdown from +0x1CC

fields.name: nextMouthInterval
fields.evidence: Model_Face_Update (0x005652A4) computes it from a second 0x0051B1FC random value scaled to [0,1) seconds right after the blink countdown reload

fields.name: blinkDuration
fields.evidence: Model_Face_Update (0x005652A4) reloads blinkCountdown (+0x1D0) from it whenever the countdown expires and a new blink is scheduled

fields.name: blinkCountdown
fields.evidence: Decremented by deltaTime each Model_Face_Update and reloaded from f_1CC.

fields.name: blinkScheduleTimer
fields.evidence: Model_Face_Update (0x005652A4) only advances the countdown and reschedules a blink while this float is greater than zero

fields.name: maybe_blendValue3
fields.evidence: Fourth blend value of the reset group.
